why_a_rerun_would_not_help: K1711's headline limitation is that the exercise is retrospective pseudo-OOS: TimesFM and TTM weights post-date the evaluation sample. That is a permanent property of evaluating today's public zero-shot weights on historical data, not an artifact of how K1711 was run. A fresh run in this worktree would reproduce the identical caveat while consuming a second xhigh budget, and would land as the tenth ML-ceiling null the brief explicitly warns against.
unresolved: Nested QLIKE pairs (HAR vs HAR-bearing combinations) remain INCONCLUSIVE_NO_VALID_GENERAL_LOSS_NESTED_TEST. This is a genuine open methodological gap, but it is a known repo-wide limitation (see reference memory 'nested + pinball + expanding has no valid inference method'), not something this task could close. Clark-West is admissible only for secondary MSE inference and cannot be repurposed for QLIKE.

Measurement quality is heterogeneous across markets: SPY and 0050.TW use daily OHLC Garman-Klass proxies while only TX uses local 5-min RV. Harmonising SPY/0050.TW onto intraday RV would be a legitimate follow-up experiment, distinct from re-running K1711 as specified.
Model-vintage-clean evaluation is bounded by disclosure: TimesFM has a documented training cutoff but TTM's is unstated, so the post-2024-01 robustness window cannot be certified contamination-free.
